question: Which of the following politicians was posthumously awarded the Padma Vibhushan by the President of India in the year 2023 for his significant contribution in the field of public affairs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mulayam Singh Yadav**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The politician who was posthumously awarded the Padma Vibhushan by the President of India in the year 2023 for his significant contribution in the field of public affairs was Mulayam Singh Yadav.
 
• He was the former Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh and former Defense Minister of India. He was the founder of Samajwadi Party.
 
• Mulayam Singh Yadav died on 10 October 2022. He was known for his socialist ideology, his dedication to the poor and farmers and his calm and cordial personality in politics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Sharad Yadav**

 
• ​Sharad Yadav is an Indian politician who is the President of Janata Dal (United). He is a supporter of socialist ideology and is known for his work for the poor and farmers.
 
• Sharad Yadav was born on 18 June 1940 in Ballia district of Uttar Pradesh. He studied law from Allahabad University. He won the election for the first time in 1967 and became a member of the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly.
 
• Sharad Yadav won the Lok Sabha elections for the first time in 1977 as a member of the Janata Party. He was elected to the Lok Sabha in 1980, 1984, 1989, 1991, 1996, 1998, 1999, 2004 and 2009.

**Balkrishna Doshi**

 
• Balkrishna Vithaldas Doshi is a famous architect of India.
 
• He has been awarded Britain's prestigious award 'Royal Gold Medal' (2022). This award is considered special in the world of architecture.
 
• In 2020, the Government of India awarded the Padma Bhushan to Balkrishna Doshi.

**Naba Das**

 
• ​Naba Kishore Das (7 January 1962 – 29 January 2023) was an Indian politician who was a member of the Odisha Legislative Assembly from 2009 until his assassination, representing Jharsuguda.
 
• Originally a member of the Indian National Congress, he later joined the Biju Janata Dal.
